answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and join a Semaphore identity tree, evaluating an epoch polynomial whose committed coefficients bind an RLN rate-limit secret. Each message proves membership and consistency with the polynomial identity commitment. Duplicate messages in one epoch and scope expose two Shamir shares at the same input; interpolation reveals the private key, and an on-chain verifier instantly slashes collateral. The prism, violet, and jade channels follow this rule.
